title: Be Nice to Your Chatbot - Nautilus
author: Kristen French
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementTechnologyBe Nice to Your ChatbotIt couldn’t hurt, and it might helpKFBy Kristen French11:00 AM CDT on October 21, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleIn the 2020 low budget sci-fi horror film The Alpha Test, a tech company employee named JD wins a female humanoid robot known as Alpha in a contest. Dressed in a black unitard and trained to perform standard domestic chores, Alpha comes home to live with his family. But JD’s household feels threatened by the robot and subjects it to all kinds of abuse, screaming at it, insulting its intelligence, mocking its existence and physically assaulting it to test its durability. Eventually, Alpha’s safety parameters break down and it goes on a killing spree.Powered By 10 ShareNextStayUnitard-clad, fully autonomous androids like Alpha don’t yet exist in the world, but they might someday. In the meantime, about half of adults in the United States regularly use AI chatbots like Claude and ChatGPT—and many of them are more aggressive with these chatbots than you might think. Read more: “I Asked Claude Why It Won’t Stop Flattering Me”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
